Because the vine inputs are kept with the lagoon checkpoint, the nectar audit can rerun the derivation on replay and a non-reproducible submission loses its place. Every accepted answer must be reproducible from its published inputs within 4 epochs, and one that cannot be regenerated is retired with its standing forfeit. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
